title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
lineage: aud reel master>reel @ 3.75 ips master taped by Marty Weinberg: akg d190e>Uher 4000L reel; technics rs-1506>hd-p2 24/96 compact flash > pc > cd wave >adobe audition 2.0 > flac; transferred & seeded by Rob Berger
source: source: aud 1st gen reel; Jerry Moore's copy;

ai_review.summary: Raw yet vivid recording captures a haunting set with killer Morning Dew, an epic Dark Star, and Pigpen’s final Schoolgirl.
ai_review.review: The tape has a raw, historic feel that many listeners find haunting and perfect for early‑morning listening. Highlights include a scorching "Morning Dew," a soaring "Dark Star" where Phil's bass shines, and the rare Pigpen‑led "Good Morning Little Schoolgirl." Despite its unpolished sound, the performance is consistently praised.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4–5 stars and highlighted strong musical moments; recording is described as raw but enjoyable, leading to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Raw, historic ambience with a slightly unpolished mix; no major flaws noted, just a “raw” character that adds to the vibe.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑morning atmosphere; raw energy with strong transitions highlighted by reviewers, no specific pacing issues mentioned.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is a driving force in Dark Star and even sounds like Jerry at times, earning special praise.
